title: Online Bayesian Inference for a Dirichlet Process Mixture of Binary Logit Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06266v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flexible travel behaviour models for preference heterogeneity have largely remained within the batch-estimation paradigm. The growing availability of continuously collected behavioural data, for example from smartphone applications, highlights the need for methods that update posterior inference on such heterogeneity as new observations arrive. This study proposes an online Bayesian inference method for a Dirichlet process mixture of binary logit models. The main challenge is to update the posterior as observations arrive while allowing the latent cluster structure to expand and historical cluster assignments to be revised. We develop a sequential Monte Carlo sampler using a sequence of P\'olya--Gamma-augmented partial-data posteriors, local particle-weight corrections, and recursively maintained sufficient statistics. translated_title: 二元Logit模型的狄利克雷过程混合模型的在线贝叶斯推断
translated_abstract: 针对偏好异质性的灵活出行行为模型在很大程度上仍停留在批量估计范式之中。持续采集的行为数据（例如来自智能手机应用程序）日益可得，凸显了对能够随新观测到来而更新此类异质性后验推断的方法的需求。本研究提出了一种针对二元Logit模型狄利克雷过程混合的在线贝叶斯推断方法。其主要挑战在于：在观测陆续到达时更新后验，同时允许潜在簇结构进行扩展，并允许对历史簇分配进行修正。我们开发了一种序贯蒙特卡洛采样器，其基于一系列经Pólya-Gamma增广的部分数据后验、局部粒子权重修正，以及递归维护的充分统计量。每个观测的贡献都可以在这些统计摘要中被添加、移除或替换，从而同时支持序贯系数估计……
tldr: 提出了一种针对二元Logit模型狄利克雷过程混合的在线贝叶斯推断方法，通过基于Pólya-Gamma增广的序贯蒙特卡洛采样器，随着新数据到来动态更新偏好异质性的后验推断，并支持潜在簇结构的扩展与历史分配的修正。
en_tdlr: Proposes an online Bayesian inference method for a Dirichlet process mixture of binary logit models, using a Pólya-Gamma-augmented sequential Monte Carlo sampler that updates posterior inference on preference heterogeneity as new data arrive, while allowing latent cluster structures to expand and historical assignments to be revised.
